versions.changelog:
Initial release: Autonomous Uniswap protocol fee claim pipeline for TokenJar and Firepit.

- Analyzes TokenJar balances, prices assets, and calculates profitability vs. UNI burn and gas costs.
- Provides a one-command workflow with safety-gated preview and optional execution.
- Delivers a clear profitability dashboard (gross/net profit, ROI, asset breakdown).
- Supports post-burn stablecoin conversion and detailed execution/reporting workflow.
- Defaults to preview-only mode; explicit user opt-in required for execution.
